## Change / 改动

Describe the visible behavior or maintenance change and its reason. / 说明实际行为或维护流程变化及原因。

## Documentation and media / 文档与媒体

List the bilingual guides, changelog/release note and refreshed media that accompany this change. / 列出同步的双语文档、更新记录、发布说明和演示素材。

## Validation / 验证

Include `npm run release:check` and relevant browser or deployment verification. / 记录完整检查和相应的浏览器或部署验证。
